newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia evacuates 14 diplomatic kin from Albania.
newsitem.headline: Russia evacuates 14 diplomatic kin from Albania.

text.p: Russia is evacuating 14 diplomatic family members from Albania and has drawn up plans to repatriate all Russians there if the situation worsens, the Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.
"Moscow is watching with concern the situation in Albania which remains tense," spokesman Gennady Tarasov told a briefing.
"At the present time, 14 people are leaving the country. We also have concrete plans to evacuate all diplomatic service personnel and other Russian citizens if need be," he said.
There are nearly 300 Russians living in Albania, he said.
Tarasov also said that Russia was in touch with the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe and was ready to take part in diplomatic efforts to calm the situation.
An anti-government uprising, sparked by the collapse of pyramid savings schemes, has plunged Albania into anarchy.
